question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
-- Average total quantity across all final packaging combinations
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id as top_id,
    p.id as current_id,
    p.name as current_name,
    1 as qty_multiplier,
    0 as depth
  FROM packaging p
  WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    pt.top_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    p2.name,
    pt.qty_multiplier * pr.qty,
    pt.depth + 1
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
  JOIN packaging p2 ON pr.contains_id = p2.id
),
leaf_items AS (
  SELECT 
    pt.top_id,
    pt.current_id,
    pt.current_name,
    pt.qty_multiplier
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  WHERE pt.current_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    top_id,
    SUM(qty_multiplier) as total_leaf_qty
  FROM leaf_items
  GROUP BY top_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_qty) as average_total_quantity
FROM totals
